derivation: Threshold minimises expected INR cost per dispute on val under the 'balanced' scenario, with scores prior-shifted and the population re-weighted to an assumed dispute-queue fraud rate of 50%, then applied unchanged to test. Review band is the region where expected cost is within one human review (INR 150) of the optimum. Disputes above INR 25,000 bypass this entirely.
caveat: assumed_dispute_fraud_rate is STATED, not measured. IEEE-CIS has no dispute queue. See evaluation/cost_curve.json prevalence_sensitivity for how the threshold and the model's edge move across 3.5%-65%.
